instructions.name: accept_authority
docs: F17 Step 2: the proposed pubkey signs to atomically swap itself into
the authority slot and clear pending_authority.

accounts.name: new_authority
docs: The previously-proposed pubkey, signing to accept the rotation.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Anyone can crank this (permissionless).
remaining_accounts: all PathOutcome accounts for this market (for freshness check).

accounts.name: price_sample
docs: The most recent PriceSample for this market.
F19: `completed_checkpoints - 1` is safe because the `market` account
constraint above rejects calls where completed_checkpoints == 0.

accounts.name: keeper
docs: Permissionless keeper

accounts.name: treasury

accounts.name: insurance_fund

instructions.name: close_path_outcome
docs: F7: the path's original creator closes a PathOutcome belonging to a
Settled/Void market. Creator-only (NOT permissionless) to prevent
griefing-DoS on unclaimed positions. Rent returns to the creator.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Rent destination AND signer — creator-only closure. See module
docstring for why this isn't permissionless.

instructions.name: close_position
docs: F7: user closes their own claimed Position. Rent returns to the user.

accounts.name: market
docs: Passed so the handler can reconstruct the Position PDA's original
seeds (which use `market.market_id.to_le_bytes()` — 8 bytes, NOT the
32-byte market pubkey). Market is self-authenticating via its own
seed derivation, so a user can't supply a spoofed Market here.

accounts.name: user
docs: Rent destination — must match the user stored in the position.

instructions.name: close_price_sample
docs: F7: anyone closes a PriceSample belonging to a Settled/Void market.
Permissionless — PriceSample isn't read post-settlement. Rent returns
to the keeper that originally posted the sample.

accounts.name: sampled_by
docs: Rent destination — the keeper that originally posted this sample.
Permissionless: no post-settlement handler reads PriceSample, so
there's no DoS risk from closing early. Any caller can trigger
closure; the `constraint` above pins rent flow to the original keeper.
PriceSample's `sampled_by` field doesn't match the Accounts field
name, so we use an explicit constraint rather than `has_one`.

accounts.name: insurance_fund
docs: Insurance fund receives the market creation fee

accounts.name: creator_token_account
docs: Creator's USDC token account — pays the creation fee

instructions.name: exit_position
docs: `min_payout_out` — F4 slippage floor. Reverts with `SlippageExceeded`
if the LMSR sell value net of settlement rake would be less than
requested. Pass 0 to opt out.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury — receives settlement rake share (same account as ProtocolState.treasury)

accounts.name: insurance_fund
docs: Insurance fund — receives settlement rake share

accounts.name: token_program
docs: remaining_accounts[0]: Optional EigenCache (mut) — for quantum-correlated
pricing and perturbation. Loaded via eigen_utils::load_eigen_cache().

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Permissionless

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Permissionless

instructions.name: migrate_protocol_state_v2
docs: One-time ProtocolState v1 → v2 migration. Appends the three new fields
(pending_authority, collateral_mint, keeper_authority) and sets them to
caller-supplied values. Admin-gated by protocol_state.authority AND by
the hardcoded EXPECTED_DEPLOYER check (test-mode disables the latter).
Safe to call exactly once per ProtocolState lifecycle.

accounts.name: protocol_state
docs: compiled `ProtocolState::INIT_SPACE` (v1 = 909 bytes vs v2 = 1006),
so we can't use `Account<ProtocolState>` — Anchor's auto-deser fails
before anything else runs. Anchor 0.31 also rejects `realloc` on
`UncheckedAccount`. Solution: do the realloc manually inside the
handler and validate ownership + discriminator + stored-authority
there too. Canonical PDA derivation is still enforced by the
`seeds`/`bump` attributes below.

instructions.name: place_wager
docs: `min_shares_out` — F4 slippage floor. Reverts with `SlippageExceeded`
if LMSR quantities move between submit+land such that the caller would
receive fewer shares than requested. Pass 0 to opt out.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury token account — receives 80% of entry fee

accounts.name: insurance_fund
docs: Insurance fund token account — receives 20% of entry fee

accounts.name: token_program
docs: remaining_accounts[0]: Optional EigenCache (mut) — pass the PDA if a
verified eigendecomp is available, or omit for λ=0 fallback.
Loaded via eigen_utils::load_eigen_cache() to avoid BPF stack overflow.

instructions.name: propose_authority
docs: F17 Step 1: current authority proposes a new authority. Stages the new
pubkey in pending_authority; no effect on live authority yet.

accounts.name: disputer_token_account
docs: Required only when `uphold = true`.

instructions.name: sample_and_dissolve
docs: Combined sample + dissolve: sample oracle checkpoint and process all
paths' decoherence in one transaction. Paths via remaining_accounts.
This is the primary production sampling path (levx-infra keeper).

accounts.name: pyth_price_update
docs: Pyth PriceUpdateV2 account — must be owned by the Pyth Receiver Program.

accounts.name: pyth_price_update
docs: Pyth PriceUpdateV2 account — must be owned by the Pyth Receiver Program.
The keeper posts the price update to Pyth's receiver program in a prior
instruction within the same transaction. We read the verified result here.

accounts.name: keeper
docs: Permissionless keeper

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Permissionless

instructions.name: update_collateral_mint
docs: F11 governance escape hatch: rotate the allowlisted collateral mint.
Admin-only (has_one = authority). Required because migrate is
one-shot — this gives us a recovery path for typos and a migration
path if the canonical mint ever changes (e.g. USDC → USDG).

accounts.name: new_collateral_mint
docs: Validated by Anchor: must be owned by SPL Token program and decode
as a real `Mint`. Rejects System Program pubkeys, token accounts,
arbitrary data accounts.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Permissionless

types.name: AuthorityAccepted
docs: F17 step 2. `previous` is the authority that existed before this tx.

types.name: AuthorityProposed
docs: F17 step 1.

types.name: ClaimPaid
docs: Emitted by `claim` (sealed, Phase 6.2).

types.name: CollateralMintUpdated
docs: F11 governance escape hatch.

fields.name: lambda
docs: Quantum coupling strength (0 = no correlation, reduces to LMSR pricing).

fields.name: reference_action
docs: Expected action of a random-walk path over the market duration.
Used by exponential scoring: score = exp(-action / reference_action).
Keeper computes off-chain from historical volatility.

fields.name: weight_qv
docs: Multi-feature scoring weights (fixed-point 6 dec, sum ≈ SCALE).
Features modulate action score as penalties.

fields.name: nudge_rate
docs: LMSR oracle nudge rate (fixed-point 6 dec). Default 50_000 (5%).
0 = disabled. Per-checkpoint zero-sum quantity adjustment from oracle data.

fields.name: lmsr_alpha
docs: LS-LMSR alpha (fixed-point 6 dec). `None` falls back to 50_000 (0.05).
Larger values prevent q/b saturation in the softmax at the cost of
flatter initial pricing — useful for tests or markets that expect
large sequential wagers without submitting eigendecomp between them.

types.name: DisputeBond
docs: Per-market bond locked by the account that raised a dispute.

types.name: DisputeConfig
docs: Governance-managed dispute-bond policy.
Kept in its own PDA so we can add bonded disputes without resizing the live
ProtocolState account layout.

fields.name: min_bond_amount
docs: Minimum bond in the protocol collateral mint's base units.

fields.name: bond_bps
docs: Market-pool percentage in basis points.

fields.name: max_bond_amount
docs: Maximum bond in the protocol collateral mint's base units.

fields.name: review_grace_period
docs: Extra review period after maturity_end_time before timeout finalization.

types.name: EigenCache
docs: Cached eigendecomposition for a market's quantum cost function.
Populated by `submit_eigendecomp` (permissionless keeper).
Read by `place_wager` and `exit_position` for quantum-correlated pricing.
Uses Vec fields with #[max_len] instead of fixed arrays to avoid
BPF stack overflow during Anchor's init serialization.
Fresh when `version == market.eigendecomp_version`.

fields.name: market
docs: The market this decomposition is for.

fields.name: eigenvalues
docs: Eigenvalues of M = (diag(q) + λK) / b, fixed-point i64.

fields.name: eigenvectors_flat
docs: Eigenvector matrix Q (row-major: entry [i*n + k] = k-th component of i-th eigenvector).
This is the TRANSPOSE of the Jacobi output (which stores eigenvectors as columns).

fields.name: num_paths
docs: Number of active curated paths when this was computed.

fields.name: version
docs: Matches market.eigendecomp_version when fresh.

fields.name: cached_prices
docs: Quantum prices at checkpoint time: p_i = Σ_k |Q[i][k]|² × exp(λ_k) / Tr(exp(M))

fields.name: lipschitz_constant
docs: Lipschitz constant L = SCALE² / b for the quadratic payment rule.
Between checkpoints: cost = p_eff × s + (L/2) × s² where p_eff = cached_p + L × Δq.

fields.name: checkpoint_quantities
docs: Share quantities when this eigendecomp was computed.
Delta from checkpoint: Δq_i = market.lmsr_share_quantities[i] - checkpoint_quantities[i]

fields.name: utilization_rate
docs: total_borrowed / total_deposits (fixed-point 6 dec)

fields.name: haircut_ratio
docs: h = min(1, vault_residual / total_profit_claims); fixed-point 6 dec

fields.name: current_shortfall
docs: USDC amount of unresolved bad debt (6 decimals)

fields.name: haircut_active
docs: True when haircut ratio H < 1.0 (quick-read flag)

fields.name: pair_shortfall_count
docs: Number of pair buffers currently in deficit

fields.name: backstop_liquidator
docs: Governance-configured fallback liquidator. system_program::ID = disabled.

fields.name: backstop_grace_period
docs: Seconds before backstop can act after health drops. Default 300.

fields.name: lmsr_alpha
docs: Alpha parameter for adaptive liquidity: b = α × Σ|q_j| (fixed-point 6 dec; default 50_000 = 0.05)

fields.name: lmsr_share_quantities
docs: Share quantities per path. Input to both LMSR and quantum cost functions.

fields.name: lambda
docs: Quantum coupling strength. 0 = no inter-path correlation (reduces to LMSR).

fields.name: eigendecomp_version
docs: Monotonic counter incremented on every trade that changes quantities.
EigenCache is fresh only when its version matches this value.

fields.name: action_alpha
docs: Alpha coefficient for price term: S = α(Δp)² + β(Δv)². Default: 700_000 (0.7)

fields.name: action_beta
docs: Beta coefficient for velocity term. Default: 300_000 (0.3)

fields.name: amplitudes
docs: Amplitude for each path. Born rule: probability ~ |ψ_i|²

fields.name: amplitude_scale
docs: Scale factor for amplitude normalization. Default: 1_000_000

fields.name: decoherence_rate
docs: Rate at which deviating paths decohere. Default: 500_000 (0.5)

fields.name: minimum_probability
docs: Minimum Born probability below which a path decoheres. Default: 10_000 (1%)
Independent of path count — always means "below X% implied probability."

fields.name: nudge_rate
docs: LMSR oracle nudge rate (fixed-point 6 dec). Default: 50_000 (5%).
After each checkpoint, surviving paths' LMSR quantities are nudged toward
better-tracking paths (lower action → positive nudge). Zero-sum across paths.
Set to 0 to disable oracle-informed pricing.

fields.name: reference_score
docs: ELF reference score. Set to 0 for standard parimutuel behavior.
When > 0, paths scoring below this threshold get zero payout (ELF mechanism).
Governance can raise this once real market data calibrates reference_action.

fields.name: total_weighted_excess
docs: Sum of (max(0, score - reference_score) × total_wagered) for surviving paths.
When reference_score = 0, this equals the old total_weighted_score.

fields.name: total_weighted_fallback
docs: Sum of (score × total_wagered) for surviving paths — fallback denominator
used when all paths score below reference_score (total_weighted_excess = 0).

fields.name: paths_scored
docs: Number of paths that have been scored during settling.

fields.name: paths_dissolved
docs: Number of dissolved paths (incremented in check_dissolution).

fields.name: reference_action
docs: Expected action of a random-walk path over the market duration.
Used by exponential scoring: score = exp(-action / reference_action).
Set at market creation from historical volatility. Eliminates the
keeper-supplied max_action parameter and its griefing vector.

fields.name: weight_qv
docs: QV error weight. Default: 375_000 (37.5% of feature budget)

fields.name: weight_dd
docs: Max drawdown error weight. Default: 375_000 (37.5% of feature budget)

fields.name: weight_endpoint
docs: Endpoint error weight. Default: 125_000 (12.5% of feature budget)

fields.name: weight_displacement
docs: Displacement error weight. Default: 125_000 (12.5% of feature budget)

types.name: MarketSettled
docs: Emitted by `settle_market` (sealed, Phase 6.3) when settling transitions
Settling → Maturing or Settling → Settled (all-dissolved).

types.name: MarketVoided
docs: Emitted by both oracle-triggered `void_market` and admin `void_market_governance`.
`reason`: 0 = oracle skip threshold exceeded, 1 = governance emergency.

fields.name: origin
docs: 0 = Ai, 1 = UserDrawn (matches `PathOrigin` enum ordering).

types.name: PathDissolved
docs: Emitted by `sample_and_dissolve` (sealed, Phase 6.4), once per path
that transitions to `dissolved == true` inside the batch.

fields.name: predicted_prices
docs: Predicted checkpoint prices stored on-chain (fixed-point u64, 6 decimals).
Populated at path creation via add_path. Immutable after creation.
Keepers read directly via index — no Merkle proofs needed.

fields.name: cumulative_action
docs: Cumulative action S = Σ[α(Δp)² + β(Δv)²] across checkpoints. Lower = better.

fields.name: composite_score
docs: Final composite score (0 to 1_000_000). Set during settlement.

fields.name: peak_amplitude
docs: Highest amplitude this path reached (for decoherence payout ratio)

fields.name: amplitude_at_decoherence
docs: Amplitude when path was marked decohered (0 if still alive)

fields.name: checkpoints_processed
docs: Number of checkpoints processed via check_dissolution (must equal
total_checkpoints for score_path to accept this path)

fields.name: total_time_weighted_exposure
docs: Time-weighted notional exposure: Σ(collateral × remaining_checkpoints / total_checkpoints).
Accumulated at wager time. Used in ELF denominators so payout sums match distributable pool.

fields.name: pred_quadratic_variation
docs: Predicted quadratic variation: Σ(pred_return_i²). Measures predicted path roughness.

fields.name: actual_quadratic_variation
docs: Actual quadratic variation: Σ(actual_return_i²). Ground truth path roughness.

fields.name: pred_peak_price
docs: Running peak of predicted prices (for drawdown tracking).

fields.name: pred_max_drawdown
docs: Max drawdown of predicted path: max(peak - trough) / peak, fixed-point.

fields.name: actual_peak_price
docs: Running peak of actual prices (for drawdown tracking).

fields.name: actual_max_drawdown
docs: Max drawdown of actual path: max(peak - trough) / peak, fixed-point.

fields.name: first_predicted_price
docs: First checkpoint's predicted price (for displacement feature).

fields.name: first_actual_price
docs: First checkpoint's actual price (for displacement feature).

types.name: PathScored
docs: Emitted by `score_path` (sealed, Phase 6.5).

fields.name: collateral
docs: Actual USDC deposited (after entry fee)

fields.name: leverage
docs: 1 for Mode 1; 2-50 for Mode 2

fields.name: notional_exposure
docs: collateral × leverage

fields.name: lmsr_shares
docs: Shares held via LMSR pricing

fields.name: cost_basis
docs: Total USDC paid for shares (for P&L tracking)

fields.name: health_factor
docs: Effective collateral / estimated loss (fixed-point 6 dec)

fields.name: liquidation_threshold
docs: Health factor below which liquidation triggers (1_100_000 = 1.1)

types.name: PositionExited
docs: Phase 7: F4 + F9 rework. `user_payout` is the post-rake amount sent to
the user; `treasury_share` + `insurance_share` together are the
settlement rake (same 90/10 split as `ClaimPaid`). For a pre-settlement
exit in a healthy market, both rake shares are non-zero; for edge cases
where `payout == 0` all three are zero.

fields.name: price
docs: Price in quote decimals (USDC = 6 decimals)

fields.name: confidence
docs: Pyth confidence interval (normalized to 6 decimals)

fields.name: sampled_by
docs: Keeper address (for reward distribution). Pyth verification is enforced
upstream by the Pyth Receiver program's account owner constraint — no
per-sample flag stored on-chain.

fields.name: sampled_at_slot
docs: Solana slot for ordering verification

fields.name: low_confidence
docs: True if confidence > 2% of price; weighted at 50% in scoring

types.name: ProtocolMigratedV2
docs: F11 foundation (Phase 2). Emitted once at v1→v2 migrate.

fields.name: supported_pairs
docs: Governance-managed pair whitelist

fields.name: max_fee_cap_bps
docs: Hardcoded ceiling — not governable

fields.name: market_creation_fee
docs: Market creation fee in USDC (6 decimals). Default 10_000_000 (10 USDC).

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: F17: pending authority for the two-step rotation pattern. Set by
`propose_authority` from the current authority; consumed by
`accept_authority` which must be signed by the proposed key.
Zero-initialized (`None`) immediately after migrate.

fields.name: collateral_mint
docs: F11: the sole mint accepted as collateral by `create_market`. Stops
attacker-run "shadow markets" that pair real fees with a fake mint.
Zero-initialized to `Pubkey::default()` immediately after migrate;
must be set to the production USDC mint before F11 lands.

fields.name: keeper_authority
docs: F21: pubkey authorized to call `add_path` with
`generation_method = PathOrigin::Ai`. User-drawn paths remain
permissionless. Zero-initialized to `Pubkey::default()` immediately
after migrate; must be set to the infra keeper pubkey before F21
lands.

fields.name: index
docs: Original index of the pair that was removed.

fields.name: new_num_supported_pairs
docs: `num_supported_pairs` after the removal — equivalent to the
pre-removal index of the entry that was swapped into `index`.

fields.name: base_mint
docs: The pair that was removed (sourced from the original slot at
`index` before the swap-remove ran).

fields.name: replacement_base_mint
docs: The pair that moved into `index` as part of swap-remove. When
`index == new_num_supported_pairs` the swap was a no-op (the
removed entry was already the last one); in that case this
field is `TokenPair::default()` so consumers can short-circuit
without re-reading state.

types.name: TokenPair
docs: A whitelisted trading pair.

types.name: WagerPlaced
docs: Emitted by `place_wager` (sealed, Phase 6.1).
